course.title: Engineering Alloys and Materials Selection
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: An industry needs to design an eco-friendly packaging solution. Identify the (15) primary considerations for materials selection with respect to environmental <sub>impact.</sub> Suggest a material and explain how it meets the criteria for sustainability, recyclability, and cost-effectiveness.
